notes: Every wave's ticks matches its denominator (2, 3, 4, 5), so each item lands exactly on a mark, and 2/4 sits on the middle of the quarters line. The interior ticks are the board's equal-part divisions, not marks that point at an item. Titles and subs only say what to do. All strings are Roman Hinglish with digits only. The quarters and fifths waves would trip a child who names a fraction by counting marks (3 marks read as thirds, 4 marks as quarters).
